title: 第13章 练神识第14章 初成
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
就在三人说笑间，一道熟悉的身影悄然出现在洞府门口。
三人连忙整了整衣衫，齐声行礼：拜见师父！
墨炎真尊目光在二徒弟身上停留片刻，微微颔首：都进来吧。
说罢便转身步入洞府。
三人紧随其后，在洞府内依次落座。
司瑾淮眉飞色舞地讲起历练时的见闻，什么秘境探宝、妖兽搏杀，听得宁知初两眼放光，恨不能亲身跑到现场去吃瓜。
看来此次历练你收获不小。
墨炎真尊满意地捋须，回去好生巩固修为。
对了，可有老四的消息？
四师弟似乎进了处秘境。
司瑾淮答道。
墨炎真尊点点头，转向于南兮：境界已稳，接下来有何打算？
弟子想接个宗门任务外出历练。
于南兮眼中闪着跃跃欲试的光。
也好。
墨炎真尊沉吟道，为师给你的剑气可还够用？
这个嘛...于南兮眼珠一转，搓着手笑道，师傅，能不能...再多给几道？
宁知初在一旁听得目瞪口呆——师姐这顺杆爬的功夫，当真值得好生学习！
墨炎真尊嘴角微抽，却出人意料地取出一枚玉佩：内有为师三道剑气。
于南兮先是一愣，随即懊恼地接过玉佩——早知师父这般爽快，就该多要几道的！

莫要太过依赖外物。
墨炎真尊意味深长地提醒，自身修为才是根本。
师父放心！
于南兮拍着胸脯保证，不到生死关头，弟子绝不动用！
一旁的司瑾淮看得眼热，忍不住插话：师傅，弟子也想要几道剑气防身...
墨炎真尊似笑非笑，你也想外出历练？
弟子才刚回来啊！
司瑾淮哀嚎一声，引得众人哄堂大笑。
墨炎真尊对二徒弟的耍宝视若无睹，淡然道：都散了吧，为师要闭关几日。
目光转向小徒弟时，语气柔和了几分：修炼上若有疑问，尽管找你师兄师姐。
宗门藏书阁也随时可以去逛逛。
徒儿记下啦~宁知初乖巧点头，眼睛却亮晶晶的，显然是对藏书阁很感兴趣。
content_en:
While the three of them were chatting and laughing, a familiar figure quietly appeared at the door of the cave.
The three people quickly straightened their clothes and saluted in unison: Meet Master!
Zhenzun Mo Yan's eyes stayed on the second disciple for a moment, and he nodded slightly: "Come in, everyone."
After saying that, he turned around and walked into the cave.
The three of them followed closely and took their seats in the cave.
Si Jinhuai talked with excitement about what he had experienced during the training, such as treasure hunting in secret realms and monster beast fights. Ning Zhichu's eyes lit up when he heard that, and he wished he could go to the scene to eat melons in person.
It seems that you have gained a lot from this experience.
Zhenzun Mo Yan stroked his beard with satisfaction and went back to live a good life and consolidate his cultivation.
By the way, is there any news about the fourth child?
The fourth junior brother seemed to have entered a secret realm.
Si Jinhuai replied.
Zhenzun Mo Yan nodded and turned to Yu Nanxi: The realm has been stabilized, what are your plans next?
The disciple wants to take on a sect mission and go out to practice.
Yu Nanxi's eyes sparkled with eagerness to try.
That's fine.
Zhenzun Mo Yan said in a deep voice, is the sword energy given to you by your master still enough?
Well... Yu Nanxi rolled his eyes, rubbed his hands and said with a smile, Master, can you... give me a few more?
Ning Zhichu was dumbfounded when he heard this - Senior sister's skill of climbing along the pole is really worth learning!
The corners of Zhenzun Mo Yan's mouth twitched slightly, but unexpectedly he took out a jade pendant: it contained the three sword energies of Master.
Yu Nanxi was stunned for a moment, then took the jade pendant in annoyance - if he had known that the master was so cheerful, he should have asked for more!
Don't rely too much on external things.
Zhenzun Mo Yan meaningfully reminded that one's own cultivation is the foundation.
Don’t worry, Master!
Yu Nanxi patted her chest and promised that the disciple would never use it until it was a life or death situation!
Si Jinhuai on the side looked hot and couldn't help but interject: Master, this disciple also wants some sword energy for self-defense...
Zhenzun Mo Yan seems to be smiling but not smiling. Do you also want to go out and practice?
The disciple has just returned!
Si Jinhuai wailed, causing everyone to burst into laughter.
Zhenzun Mo Yan turned a blind eye to the two disciples' tricks and said calmly: "Let's all disperse. I will be in seclusion for a few days as my master."
When he turned his eyes to the young apprentice, his tone was a little softer: If you have any questions about cultivation, feel free to ask your senior brother or sister.
You can also visit the Zongmen Library at any time.
Disciple, take note~ Ning Zhichu nodded obediently, but his eyes were bright, obviously he was very interested in the library.
